vulkanfixes.config.title: VulkanFixes
vulkanfixes.config.motionBlur.tooltip: Blurs the world along the camera's movement so turning looks smoother. Doesn't delay frames, and the hand and HUD stay sharp.
vulkanfixes.config.screenshotToClipboard: Each screenshot is still saved to the screenshots folder, and also copied to the clipboard so you can paste it straight into a chat or an image editor.
